How Does Kalshi Work?

Kalshi is not a traditional sportsbook; rather, it is a prediction market exchange fully regulated by the CFTC. There is no “house” taking the other side of your wagers as there would be at platforms like DraftKings or FanDuel; instead, event contracts are directly traded between users. For example, prediction contracts on the upcoming Los Angeles Rams vs. Denver Broncos matchup can be traded both before and during the game based on their fluctuating current market value.

Where Can You Trade With Kalshi?

Kalshi is currently available in more than 40 U.S. states to users who are 18 and older, but it is not available to residents in Massachusetts, Michigan, Nevada, and Washington (WA). Several states are also involved in ongoing legal cases challenging whether Kalshi may offer sports event contracts.
